name: tool_use
question: For each estimation tool named in the item, did the authors use it for their own analysis, use it only as a comparator, or only mention it?

other_tools.instruction: every other software for estimating population or mixed-effects model parameters that the text names and that is not among the candidates, as written in the text (a name, not a sentence); an empty list when there is none. Leave out general programming languages unless the text names their estimation functions, and tools only for data handling, plotting or simulation.
